speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. Given your history of gait and limb ataxia, I need to know if you have noticed any specific symptoms like slurred speech, difficulty swallowing, or changes in your vision recently. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Thyroid_Function_Test.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your initial labs are normal, I need to focus on the neurological specifics. Have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your legs, or perhaps involuntary muscle jerking (myoclonus)?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the asymmetry suggests a focal lesion. Do you have any history of stroke, brain surgery, or head trauma? Also, have you noticed any changes in your handwriting or difficulty buttoning your shirt? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given the confirmed MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, this is consistent with JC virus reactivation, often seen in immunocompromised states; please proceed immediately to evaluate for underlying HIV or other immunosuppression.
